Write editor types for the project into .happyview/types/, and the tsconfig.json or .luarc.json that
points editors at them

Usage: hpy happyview types [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --locked    Fail rather than update happyview.lock when it no longer matches happyview.toml
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
